text:
alex: quick postmortem follow-up from the kv OOM on prod-23 — want to lock owners/timelines for the remediation items. TL;DR: recurring fragmentation + sticky KV residency, GC pressure when burst writes + long seqs.

jamie: I can own profiling + the GC knobs workstream. plan: run heap/prof snapshots across 3 hot shards, attach jemalloc stats, and validate with the reproducer. target EOW for initial data: 3 days.

ravi: i'll take limits/eviction tuning. propose a softlimit at 85% residency and a graduated eviction policy (LRU-ish with age bias). will test on canary pool tomorrow.

meera: i'll handle fragmentation mitigation and compaction scheduling. idea: background slab compactor during low-qps windows + tune allocation arenas. need 5-day runway to prototype.

sre-bot: deploy triggered: canary/kv-canary-4 -> prod-candidate at 2026-03-24T02:15Z (auto-rollout paused).

alex: thanks. small ops checklist for each owner: 1) reproducible profile attached to ticket 2) perf regression test (latency + p95) 3) rollout plan + rollback criteria 4) telemetry dashboards updated (residency, frag-score, GC pauses).

jamie: profiling commands i'm going to run:
```
# capture heap + jemalloc stats
pkill -USR1 runtime && curl -s http://metrics/heapdump > /tmp/heap-$(date +%s).pb
cat /proc/<pid>/status; mallctl stats
```
will attach sample outputs to the ticket.

ravi: eviction tuning notes: set `kv.residency.soft_limit = 0.85`, `kv.eviction.age_bias = 0.3`, and enable `evict-incremental = true` for canary. if p99 latency jumps > 20% rollback.

meera: frag metric to add: "frag_ratio_v2" = useful_allocated_bytes / total_committed_bytes, and a moving 1h 95th. alerts: > 0.35 for 30m -> investigate.

alex: cross-check: do we need a temporary rate limit on large prefix writes? that helped last time.

jamie: yes. recommend `ingest.prefix_write_rate_limit = 500/s` as a canary throttle. will coordinate with raven for test data.

ravi: canary schedule: start 03/24 03:00Z with 10% traffic, observe 6h, bump to 30% if stable. i'll own rollback.

meera: compaction jobs: prototype uses batch size 4 shards per node, window 02:00-05:00 local. will publish config and cron in the ticket.

alex: outstanding risks: 1) compaction CPU spike -> need CPU headroom on canaries 2) eviction interactions with hot prefixes 3) unnoticed regression in embedding pipeline. tag teams accordingly.

jamie: blockers: need access to jemalloc symbolized traces (cc: infra-ops). pinged infra for SAR.

ravi: i'll post the canary config and rollback playbook in #release-war-room before kick.

meera: i'll add the frag_ratio_v2 panel to the runtime dashboard and a synthetic that writes long sequences. target done by 03/25 EOD.

alex: summary of owners/times: jamie (profiling + GC knobs) — 3d for initial profiles; ravi (limits + canary) — canary 03/24 start; meera (frag + compaction) — 5d prototype. next check-in: 03/26 15:00 UTC in this thread. please update ticket IDs when created. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: reminder set for 2026-03-26T15:00Z (check-in).

jamie: created ticket RF-4392 and uploaded initial heap dump. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RF-4392

ravi: created RF-4393 for eviction/canary config. linking.

meera: created RF-4394 for compaction prototype. attaching config diff.

alex: perfect. leaving owners to post quick status updates here daily until remediation shipped.

jamie: day1 update: heap snapshots show repeated large runs in arena 2; starting scope-limited jemalloc purge test. no perf regression so far.

ravi: day1 update: canary config applied, 10% traffic, p95 steady. eviction churn slightly higher, watching.

meera: day1 update: compactor prototype runs, CPU +8% during window, fragmentation down ~12% in test shard.

alex: great work — keep notes concise here. we'll consolidate into the postmortem follow-up doc and close RF-4392/3/4 when rolled.
